# chrome.action

The toolbar button of an extension whose manifest has an action (src/page/ext_api.odin; the shell draws it: src/browser/ext_toolbar.odin). A value set with a tabId holds for that tab only, until it closes.

Gate: no permission; contexts: Background, Popup, Tab; the manifest has an `action`. Source: `api/ext_action.widl`.
